source.queue_precondition: all candidates queued with attempt_count 0 at selection time

selection_configuration.method: 25 untouched queued venues per region; all 500 locked; alternating known/missing source-website targets; deterministic municipality-size, tourism, chain, language, venue-type and municipality balancing
selection_configuration.partition_rule: all selected venues remain locked until capture and independent adjudication are complete

power_preregistration.basis: planning only; fixed before any search on this selection
power_preregistration.caveat: The prior rate is a sizing assumption, not an acceptance criterion or guarantee.

evaluation_preregistration.policy: publish only a candidate domain with independently verified venue ownership
evaluation_preregistration.tuning_policy: no policy or evaluator changes after this selection; evaluate exactly once after complete capture and adjudication
evaluation_preregistration.non_vacuity: a system that publishes nothing cannot pass
evaluation_preregistration.acceptance: non-vacuity and official-site precision Wilson lower bound >= 0.95
evaluation_preregistration.resource_role_metrics: not evaluated by minimal URL/title fixtures
